english.title: Fail to provide name and address to authorised officer for issue of FPT - Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to provide your name and address when required to do so to an authorised officer of **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORISED LITTER AUTHORITY..) who was proposing to give you a notice under section 88 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 88(8B)(a) and (8C) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
